# Discord Decoration

> Free browser tools for composing decorated avatar images, browsing avatar presets, styling text, and extracting GIF frames.

Discord Decoration is an independent project, not affiliated with Discord. The avatar composer produces an image; it does not grant or unlock Discord's native avatar-decoration inventory or Nitro features. The canonical production origin is https://discord-decoration.art. Translated pages declare their own canonical URLs and language alternatives.

## Tools

- [Avatar composer](https://discord-decoration.art/): Combine an avatar image with a decoration and export the result.
- [Avatar gallery](https://discord-decoration.art/discord_avatar/): Browse avatar presets.
- [Decoration gallery](https://discord-decoration.art/discord_avatar_decoration/): Browse decoration assets.
- [Fonts generator](https://discord-decoration.art/discord_front/): Convert text to Unicode styles.
- [Colored text generator](https://discord-decoration.art/discord-colored-text/): Create ANSI-formatted text for Discord.
- [GIF frame extractor](https://discord-decoration.art/gif-extractor/): Extract still frames from animated GIFs.
